verdict.rationale: monday.com documents an integrations and apps directory with 850+ integrations and apps, including partner-built apps. It also claims no-code connection to "thousands of other tools" and names many specific integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, GitHub, Slack, Zendesk, Mailchimp). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace, documentation of the install and connect flow, and reconciliation of the 850+ directory count with the "thousands" claim.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace
